'''Edward Stoddard the darkest deal''' is the [[Dark]] constructed list [[Edward Stoddard]] posted on DeckTech.<ref name="dt-19443">[http://www.decktech.net/starwarsccg/deck/19443 the darkest deal], DeckTech (edward "pimpwizard69" stoddard, 22 October 2001).
